notes: PAP reference G40/1069. Whole four-room apartment in Tours' Montjoyeux district, on the second floor of a small three-storey building in a maintained landscaped residence. The complete advert describes an entrance, bright living and dining space with three French windows onto a balcony, separate fitted kitchen, two bedrooms each opening to a balcony, bathroom, separate WC with basin and extensive storage. The through-plan dwelling has east, south and west exposure, double glazing, collective heating and 2018 internal thermal insulation. A renovated 10 m2 cellar and shared bicycle room are stated. Quarterly charges of EUR 844 include heating, hot and cold water, common areas, landscaping and a caretaker; property tax is EUR 1,460. The live text contains no tenant, lease, occupied-sale or delayed-vacancy wording. PAP exposed 15 property photos plus a virtual tour and a publication date of 28 August 2026. No lift is asserted because the advert does not expose one.
